name: Fields of Spring
source:
Turning 18 is a milestone for anyone, and for Mikey, it means he's not just headed toward adulthood... he's already there!

His mediocre soccer team is scheduled for an exhibition match with the preppy high school across town. Do they even stand a chance? Navigating life as an adult and relearning teamwork has never been more tiresome. To top it all off, he's still got all the normal problems of grades, friends, bullies, school dances, and girls…

What the hell went wrong?

[From [url=https://project-rat.itch.io/fields-of-spring]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
18岁对于任何人来说都是一个里程碑，对于Mikey来说，这意味着他不仅仅是迈向成年……他已经成年了！

他的平庸足球队计划与镇另一边的预科高中进行一场表演赛。他们还有机会吗？作为一个成年人，应对生活和重新学习团队合作从未如此令人厌烦。最重要的是，他仍然面临着所有常见的问题，比如成绩、朋友、欺凌、学校舞会和女孩……

到底出了什么问题？
